title: Swing Pressure Cutoff Solenoid Short Circuit
detail_of_failure: The pump controller senses a ground fault in the swing cut-off solenoid circuit.
controller_action: • Stops to drive the swing cut-off (2-stage relief) solenoid. • After the cause of the failure is removed, the machine does not become normal until the starting switch is turned to the OFF position once.
related_information: Monitoring code The command (ON or OFF) from the controller to the swing pressure cut off (2-stage relief) solenoid can be monitored. (As long as controller's command to solenoid is "ON", the indication on the monitor is "ON" even if solenoid is not energized because there is an open circuit.) (Code: 02301 Solenoid 2) Reference information When the solenoid is ON, the swing motor relief pressure becomes "Hi".

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. REMARK For details of checking method, see “RELATED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

branches.YES: Return to the first inspection item.
